entities.name: NAS key set identifier
entities.description: A type 1 information element allocated by the network that identifies the NAS security key set. It contains a TSC flag indicating security context type and a NAS key set identifier value.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for the NAS key set identifier, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: TSC
entities.description: Type of security context flag in bit 4 of octet 1. Value 0 indicates native security context (for KSIasme or KSIamf), value 1 indicates mapped security context (for KSIsgsn or KSIamf). Does not apply when NAS key set identifier value is '111'.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier
entities.description: NAS key set identifier value in bits 3-1 of octet 1. Values 000-110 are possible identifiers; 111 means no key available (UE to network) or reserved (network to UE).

entities.name: TSC applies condition
entities.description: TSC flag does not apply when NAS key set identifier value is '111'.

relations.description: NAS key set identifier IE contains the IEI field.
NAS key set identifier IE contains the TSC field.
NAS key set identifier IE contains the NAS key set identifier value field.
TSC field is guarded by the condition that it does not apply when NAS key set identifier value is '111'.
NAS key set identifier value field is guarded by the condition that TSC does not apply when value is '111'.
